original: ほとんどの人が海の水は飲めないって知ってますよ。

en.text: Most people know sea water isn't drinkable.
Most people know that you can't drink sea water.
Most people know that sea water is undrinkable.

original: トムは水を怖がって、泳ぐのを嫌がるの。

en.text: Tom is scared of water and doesn't like to swim.
Tom is afraid of water and hates swimming.

original: 彼は、立て続けに3杯の水を飲み干した。

en.text: He drank three cups of the water, one after the other.

original: お医者さんに、脱水症状の予防のためにもっと水を飲みなさないと言われました。

en.text: The doctor advised me to drink more water to prevent dehydration.
The doctor told me to drink more water to prevent dehydration.

original: 湖の水は濁っている。

en.text: The water in the lake is murky.

original: ダムが崩れ、水は谷を飲み込んだ。

en.text: The dam burst and water flooded the valley.

original: トムは水を飲み干した。

en.text: Tom drank all the water.

original: 温かい水が欲しい。

en.text: I need warm water.
I want warm water.

original: もっと水を飲んだ方がいいと先生に言われたよ。

en.text: My doctor told me that I should drink more water.
My doctor told me I should drink more water.

original: この水はいい匂いがする。

en.text: This water smells good.

indices: 此の{この} 水(みず) は いい(#2820690)[01] 匂いがする{匂いがする}

original: トイレを使ったら、必ず水を流して手を洗うのよ。

en.text: When you use the bathroom, be sure to flush and wash your hands.

original: この水は飲めない。

en.text: This water isn't drinkable.

original: この水は飲めません。

en.text: This water is undrinkable.

original: 花の水を替えなきゃ。

en.text: I have to change the water for the flowers.

original: 水を飲んだのは誰？

en.text: Who drank the water?

original: 水も飲めない。

en.text: I can't even drink water.

original: 洗熊は水を飲みます。

en.text: The raccoon drinks water.
